notes.title: Hotfix - 1.0.6
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Travelers![/p][p][/p][p]In this Hotfix, we’ve focused on addressing several key bugs and improving stability to make your adventure smoother and more enjoyable. Check out the details below to see what has been fixed![/p][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain Memories did not hit enemies: [i]Searing Charge[/i], [i]Stygian Rush[/i], [i]World Cracker[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where rewards spawned outside the map during the Azraq boss fight[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the screen would remain white and not proceed during the final boss fight[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the top-right timer would increase abnormally when traveling to the next world via a Rift[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where bosses would fully heal by killing other monsters when [i]Dark Urge Lucid Dream[/i] was active[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Big Baam’s laser attack and Nyx’s Comet Dash attack did not deal damage to players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the tick marks on the player’s health bar appeared denser than intended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [i]Burrow[/i] Memory was not counted as a crowd control skill in related achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [i]Sparkling Water Gun[/i] Memory was not counted as a crowd control or healing skill in related achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [i]Ice Shield[/i] Memory was not counted as a crowd control or healing skill in related achievements[/p][/*][/list][p]These improvements and fixes are part of our ongoing journey to make Shape of Dreams the best experience it can be. [/p][p]We’ll continue to monitor your feedback and refine the game accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your unwavering support.[/p][p][b]– Lizard Smoothie[/b]💫[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Note
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Travelers![/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to share with you the detailed patch notes for Patch 1.0.5, rolling out today.[/p][p]We're continuing to monitor your feedback as we look ahead toward what's next.[/p][p]Thank you for playing, and good luck with the journey![/p][p][/p][h1]Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Increased bonus Stardust obtained by defeating Heroic Bosses at higher difficulties (0/1/3/5 ⇒ 0/2/4/7)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased bonus Stardust obtained from activating Evil Lucid Dreams (1 ⇒ 3)[/p][/*][*][p]In co-op games, the Light Pillar in the World of Pure White no longer requires all players to be nearby[/p][/*][*][p]Travelers can no longer be chain-stunned by the Oppressor’s hypnosis attack in Forgotten Naraka’s cave[/p][/*][*][p]Meteor Showers during Hazardous Weather in Land of Pyrana now stop after all enemies are defeated[/p][/*][*][p]The star that enhances the first obtained Essence now ignores certain Essences such as Camilla’s Gift and Metallic Crystal[/p][/*][*][p]Vesper with Reckless Leap equipped now casts Discipline at maximum range instantly if cast beyond range[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Baam’s teleport attack marker and actual hit location differed when receiving a movement speed bonus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where teleporting away and leaving summoned monsters behind on some maps occupied by Stalkers in the Eroded Isle of Despair would make progression impossible[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several text typos and translation errors[/p][/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][h2]General[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where crashes could corrupt save files, display Korean text, and break the Constellation UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the final boss cutscene sometimes wouldn’t start, leaving the screen white and starting the battle anyway[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where characters could not move upon reaching the World of Pure White[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where killing Azraq with DoT damage mid-roll caused the soul to spawn outside the map and locked the rift[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some achievements occasionally not unlocking:[/p][list][*][p]True Support, Master of Evasion, Introduction to Elements[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where aiming indicators for channeled Memories like Shadow Bullet, Bone Crusher, and Beam of Balance would remain and prevent skill casting[/p][list][*][p]This fix applies to cases when they are cast simultaneously with other Memories, auto-cast via Somnambulism Curse or Self-Writing Story Star, interrupted by CC, or canceled by death[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where buying Star Slots consecutively allowed purchases without enough Stardust[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where canceling Bone Crusher on maps affected by Distorted Space caused Memories to lock or become permanently unstoppable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where monsters gained excessive health when leveling up under the Dark Urge Lucid Dream due to HP calculation errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Memories and Essences acquired from the Altar of Transcendence were not treated as discovered[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where shared Constellation descriptions appeared in the Flexible Star list even if no shared Constellations were unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where loading a game with Essence of Frost reset the tooltip HP gain to 0[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where water sounds in certain areas of Whispering Lotus Plateau ignored volume settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Lightning Dance could teleport players past barriers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where lowercase “m” in Traveler names displayed incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Azraq would sometimes cast a basic attack without warning while using special attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Dark Moon Spear thrust tracking speed was affected by FPS[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game started with a few seconds already elapsed[/p][/*][/list][h2]Characters[/h2][list][*][p][b]Lacerta[/b] – Fixed a bug where upgrading Quick Draw removed the charge reduction effect of the Indiscriminate Barrage Star[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lacerta[/b] – Fixed a bug where Lizard Oil Star’s charge increase effect was not applied when used with other Stars enhancing dodge skills[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lacerta[/b] – Fixed a bug where the movement speed bonus of Flexible Lizard Star stacked multiple times[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nachia[/b] – Fixed a bug where the Impressive Dance Steps Star did not work or reduced buff duration[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nachia[/b] – Fixed a bug where summons sometimes spawned on the opposite side of the map when Heroic Boss cutscenes started[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nachia[/b] – Fixed a bug where summon HP displayed differently in Lobby and Recollections tooltip than in actual gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bismuth[/b] – Fixed a bug where Good Material Star did not work[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bismuth[/b] – Fixed a bug where Distorted Mind Memory was counted as Light Damage Memory instead of Dark Damage Memory in achievements[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bismuth[/b] – Fixed a bug where Valiant Heart’s damage text was displayed in blue (Ability Power) instead of the correct format[/p][/*][/list][h2]Co-Op[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Nyx’s Black Hole pulled all players except the host too strongly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where interacting with the Dream Teller and moving to another map during dialogue would lock the player’s controls[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Adventure Essence triggered even when the player was dead[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the name of the Rift of Beginnings was sometimes displayed incorrectly on the client[/p][/*][/list][h1]Performance Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed severe performance drops when gaining gradually fading shields (e.g., Mass Protection, Blizzard), especially in co-op[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly improved performance when many enemies are on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly optimized visual effects of Hunter monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Limited the number of Fireballs launched by Essence of Scorch; Fireballs are now “compressed” when exceeding the limit[/p][list][*][p]Tooltip numbers remain unchanged, but the number of actual Fireballs decreases, and their Single Target Damage increases to keep total damage equal[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum Fireballs: 40 in solo play, 15 in co-op[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Limited the number of projectiles when using “Say Hello to My Little Friends!” with Bismuth’s Pure Soul; projectiles are now “compressed” when exceeding the limit[/p][list][*][p]Tooltip numbers remain unchanged, but the number of actual projectiles decreases, and their Single Target Dameage increases to keep total damage equal[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum projectiles: 30 in solo, 20 in 2-player co-op, 10 in 3+ player co-op[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thank you for being part of our journey and for supporting notes.title: PATCH 1.0.5 INCOMING!
notes.notes:

Here’s a sneak peek at the key changes coming in the [b]1.0.5 patch[/b] scheduled for this week.[/p][p][/p][p]🔧 [b]Key Changes[/b][/p][p][b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Star Dust rewards when playing on higher difficulties or with "Nightmare Dream" activated[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted elements like Phaerana’s Meteor Shower and certain status effects that felt unfair[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed crashes that could corrupt save files[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved progression blockers on certain maps and endings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues where some achievements would not unlock properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal behavior of certain character skills and constellations[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Performance Optimizations:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced frame drops in co-op play[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance when many enemies are on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Improved late-game co-op experience for certain Memories and Essences[/p][/*][/list][p]You can check the full patch notes after the update goes live tomorrow.

notes.title: 2025/09/12 - Hotfix Note
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Travelers![/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has played Shape of Dreams and sent us various feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Since launch, we have been analyzing the play data together with your voices, and we are quickly refining the parts that need improvement.
This hotfix was prepared with a focus on easing growth stress, increasing rewards, and adjusting difficulty, which many of you have commented on.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to closely examine the data and, together with the community’s feedback, further solidify the unique fun of Shape of Dreams.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]\[Hotfix Notes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a feature to reset purchased stars[/p][/*][*][p]Now, when you press the purchase or enhance button in the constellation screen, the star is immediately purchased/enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Traveler Mastery experience improvements[/p][list][*][p]The number of points gained by beginners is increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of points gained by players who explore the world for a long time is increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of points gained by speedrunners who progress quickly through the game is increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of points required to level up when Traveler Mastery is level 20 or higher is reduced.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced enemy HP and damage growth values in Easy and Normal difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Increased base Stardust drop amount from defeating Hero Bosses (12 ⇒ 16)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Stardust reward obtained when completing achievements (40 ⇒ 50)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Stardust reward obtained when appraising relics (10 ⇒ 20)[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the animation time of Balanced Beam by 60% when it ends[/p][/*][*][p]The knockback strength of the basic attacks of Infernas, the boss of Phyrana’s Earth, now decreases as the difficulty becomes easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the burn damage duration applied to Travelers by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Relaxed the completion conditions for 11 achievements that required excessive time to complete[/p][list][*][p]"Pure Immagination", "Horns, Feathers, and Gold", "Praise the Sun!", "Elemental Lord", "Empty Canvas", "Full Moon", "Hunters? What Hunters?", "Midas Incarnate", "Mine and Craft", "I've Got This!", "Reap What You Sow"[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]With this hotfix, if the completion conditions for an achievement are now met due to the adjusted requirements, the achievement will automatically unlock when you start the game.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the stun effect duration of the red magic circle of the Seeker boss in the Cave of Oblivion by 50%[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the safe zone sometimes generated too far away during White Night’s special attack in Lotus Plateau[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where cooldown reduction was not displayed in the tooltip when enhancing Memories[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the achievement was not completed even when a soul was infused into the wooden puppet in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where reconnection or mid-session joining was not possible in certain situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the sunglasses worn by the Hollow Traveler were displayed in the wrong position[/p][/*][/list][p]We ask for your continued interest and feedback, and we will do our best to make your adventure even more enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your unwavering support.[/p][p][b]– Lizard Smoothie[/b]💫[/p]

notes.title: 2025/09/11 - Hotfix Note
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Travelers![/p][p]Thank you for the tremendous support you have shown since launch, and we also deeply empathize with the frustration and disappointment some of you have felt.[/p][p][/p][p]The Traveler Mastery system was designed to bring players a sense of growth and progression, but in many ways, we now see that we did not consider enough of its impact.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, this system failed to fully capture the core fun of [i]Shape of Dreams[/i] and did not sufficiently respect the experience of players who enjoyed the demo and prologue.[/p][p][/p][p]Based on your feedback, we have prepared this hotfix, and we will continue to monitor gameplay closely and make ongoing improvements in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Hotfix Notes][/b][/p][list][*][p]Grant Traveler Mastery rewards proportional to play time to existing demo/prologue players[/p][list][*][p]If you played the demo or prologue for more than 10 minutes, when you run the game, a reward claim window will appear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increase Stardust reward amounts for Daydream quests by 25 ~ 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Remove the time between completing a Daydream quest and assigning the next quest[/p][/*][*][p]Lower Nakia Traveler's challenge requirement from 30 defeats ⇒ 20 defeats[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce the number of points required to raise Traveler Mastery levels across the board[/p][/*][*][p]Required mastery level to unlock all Flexible Stars decreased by 5 levels[/p][/*][*][p]When upgrading Memories, the cooldown will no longer converge at 50% and will continue to decrease.[/p][list][*][p]Reflecting feedback from many demo players about enjoyment and difficulty, we have rolled back that change, which was a balance patch for the full version.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where constellation tree refunds did not work properly in some situations[/p][/*][/list][p]⚠️ [b]Please make sure to update the game before playing multiplayer.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Rules for Returning Proficiency Points:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Proficiency points will be granted proportionally based on your demo playtime. The longer you played, the more points you would receive.[/p][list][*][p]Playtime under 10 minutes: No points will be granted.[/p][/*][*][p]Playtime between 10–60 minutes: Points will be granted as if you played for 60 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Playtime over 60 minutes: Points will be granted proportionally based on your actual playtime.[/p][/*][*][p]There is a maximum limit to the points you can receive, equal to the total points required to raise all five characters from level 0 to level 25.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Granted points can be freely distributed among the five unlockable demo characters: Lacerte, Mist, Yubar, Vesper, and Aurena.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Your valuable feedback is what makes [i]Shape of Dreams[/i] truly special.
We will keep listening to your voices and deliver a smoother, more satisfying adventure.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s shape the dream together — we look forward to your continued support and participation. ✨[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for always cheering us on.
[b]– Lizard Smoothie[/b][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update & Thank You for Your Support!
notes.notes:
Hello, Travelers!

Thank you all for your incredible support during Steam Next Fest! We truly appreciate the enthusiasm and feedback you've shared. We are committed to providing the best experience possible, and to that end, we are rolling out a hotfix update to address key issues.

[h1]🔧 Hotfix Details:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where emotes could not be edited on certain devices.
[*] Improved an issue where special quest rewards could not be received in certain regions.
[*] Enhanced clarity of Nyx’s melee attack indicators to improve fairness.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mist’s critical hit animation was not playing.
[*] Fixed a bug where Flash’s basic attack did not trigger critical hits.
[*] Reduced the intensity of lighting effects for elemental effects and certain skills.
[*] Fixed a bug where some achievement names were not displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue where Wound Essence and Mist’s passive ability ignored attack effect ratios.
[*] Fixed a bug where the client displayed the stat increase of Predation Essence as 0.
[/list]

We will continue to monitor feedback and improve the game. If you encounter any additional bugs or have further suggestions, please reach out to us at sod_help@neowiz.com.

Thank you for being part of this journey! 💙

👉 Don’t forget to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444750/Shape_of_Dreams/]Shape of Dreams[/url] to your wishlist!

Thank you!
Shape of Dreams Development Team 💫

notes.title: Update #3 - Late Game Gameplay and Balance Adjustments
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940776/2b6dba876a9330084aa2b25b2007d37a68551e67.png[/img]
[h1]Late Game Gameplay and Balance Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Monster Scaling Rework[/b]
Heroic Bosses and Mini-bosses now have a steeper HP scaling curve in the late game.
All enemies now have a slightly gentler damage scaling curve in the late game.
[*] [b]Traveler Scaling Rework[/b]
Reduced base stats for all Travelers while increasing their growth stats based on their characteristics.
Melee Travelers now receive increased HP scaling and base defense.
[*] [b]Mirage Skin Rework[/b]
Mirage Skin debuff's healing reduction effect has been changed from [b]100% -> 90%[/b].
Melee Travelers now receive this debuff progressively at [b]30% -> 60% -> 90%[/b] with each hit.
[*] Added the ability to rename public lobbies
[*] Memory and Essence chat pings now show related information when hovering over them.
[/list]
Hello Travelers, Happy New Year!
Today, we've implemented our third irregular update focusing on balance and late-game experience improvements!

We're trying various solutions to address the late-game balance issues you've reported, and we've implemented some of them in this update. We'd appreciate your feedback about these changes on Discord and Steam!

[h2]Prologue is Ending Soon![/h2]
The prologue period will end before the Steam Next Fest scheduled for late February, and all content will be transferred from the prologue to the demo. We're also excited to announce that the February Steam Next Fest demo will include [b]new content updates[/b].

Don't worry - all your prologue save data will be transferred to the demo!

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased Vesper's base HP
[*] Slightly reduced HP increase and healing amount of Vesper's first passive Memory
[*] Increased healing amount of Vesper's second passive Memory
[*] Slightly increased invulnerability duration of Winter Fall Memory, enemies now ignore players casting Winter Fall
[*] Reduced damage upgrade scaling of Mist's Deflect Memory
[*] Buffed damage of Talc Essence, Sharpness Essence, and Desolation Essence
[*] Changed Blade Essence to scale with AD
[*] Changed Celestial Essence cooldown from [b]5 -> 10 seconds[/b], projectiles from [b]3 -> 4[/b], and increased damage
[*] Changed Aurena's passive Memory scaling from [b]AP -> AD[/b]
[*] Changed Arrow Rain Memory trigger condition from [b]Basic Attack -> Attack[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Travelers affected by Dark Impulse curse can now be attacked by allies
[*] Frost Essence and Blade Essence now affected by Flow Essence's cooldown reduction
[*] Game preparation screen now remembers previously selected Lucid Dream
[*] Improved various overly intense lighting effects
[*] Reduced Hunter Ambush Orb health
[*] Significantly reduced initial loading time and VRAM usage
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where resources would disappear when shared while dead
[*] Fixed a bug where some mini-bosses spawned Unstoppable despite active Lucid Dream
[*] Fixed a bug where Dream Dust increase upgrade wasn't applying when dismantling Memories
[*] Improved memory-related crashes
[*] Fixed a bug where using movement abilities before boss fights would prevent entry and freeze the game
[*] Fixed a bug showing unnecessary arrows in Obliviax map
[*] Fixed Mist's dodge ability upgrade not showing in tooltip
[*] Fixed Pure Essence triggering on self
[*] Fixed water sound volume not following settings in certain areas
[*] Fixed damage numbers showing squares in some languages
[*] Improved grammar in some language texts
[/list]
